# Golden Palm Car Trading Platform (السعفة الذهبية)

> An Arabic-language car marketplace and import-tracking platform based in Amman, Jordan.

## About

Golden Palm (السعفة الذهبية) is a car trading platform where users can browse vehicles for sale, track imported cars in transit from auction, and connect with traders. The entire interface is in Arabic with right-to-left layout.

## Primary Language

Arabic (ar)

## Key Public Pages

- / — Landing page with hero, testimonials, about us, and contact information
- /cars-for-sale — Marketplace listing page; browse all available cars for purchase with filters (make, model, year, price, body type, fuel, transmission, color, and more)
- /listing/:id — Individual car listing detail page with full specs, photos, and seller contact
- /incoming-cars — Cars currently in transit from auction; shows shipping status and estimated arrival
